description: Places a signature, stamp or logo image (a transparent PNG works best; JPEG, WebP, AVIF and JPEG XL too) on chosen pages, at a corner or at exact millimetres, keeping its proportions. This is a visible signature, not a cryptographic (digital certificate) one.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it exists

pages.description: Page ranges, e.g. "1, 3-5"; default the last page

xMM.description: Left edge from the page’s left, in mm (instead of position)

yMM.description: Bottom edge from the page’s bottom, in mm

name: pdf_sign
title: Sign or stamp a PDF
